description: Suchotnik, a gaunt desiccated husk of a man standing on two thin bony legs with bare feet, the whole body from the head to the feet inside the picture, cracked skin like dry clay, empty eye sockets with a faint red glow, dust falling from its joints, long bony fingers, menacing, full body, three-quarter view

references.usage: the creature's look chosen by the author: the same gaunt cracked husk, face and colours, but drawn whole, standing on both legs and feet
